description: The bar chart illustrates the ratio (in percent) for three language models across three knowledge domains, showing grouped bars for Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups labeled “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” arranged left to right, while the vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks at 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90 (spanning roughly 50% to 90%). Each category contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at the top: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). In Movies, the blue Llama3 bar is just under 90% (about 89%), the red Qwen2 bar is about 90%, and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around 73%. In Songs, Llama3 is around 84%, Qwen2 is about 90%, and ChatGPT is around 62%. In Basketball, Llama3 is around 66–67%, Qwen2 is around 57–58%, and ChatGPT is around 61%. The bars are grouped by domain rather than sorted by height, and there are no special visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the color legend.
